newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Thai companies to build hotel complex in Cambodia.
newsitem.headline: Thai companies to build hotel complex in Cambodia.

text.p: The Imperial Hotels Group and TCC Hotels Ltd of Thailand will build a 300-room hotel complex near Cambodia's Angkor Wat temple complex, the Ministry of Tourism said on Friday.
Imperial Angkor Palace Co. Ltd., a joint venture between the two companies, will begin construction in Siem Reap in mid-1997, officials said.
The hotel will be on six hectares (15 acres) near the Angkor Wat complex of 10th-12th century temples, according to a statement from the Tourism Ministry.
Imperial Hotels Group is a publicly owned company in Thailand, and the Cambodian hotel will be its first project outside that country, the statement said.
TCC is a privately owned firm with five hotels in Thailand and one in New York.
Siem Reap is one of Cambodia's biggest tourism attractions, drawing tens of thousands of visitors every year.
